title: printk-style Log Ring Buffer
constraints: No dynamic allocation — fixed static storage
Ring capacity 4 records; max message 31 chars + NUL
Keep a message only if level <= threshold
Overwrite the oldest record when full (never drop newest)
Truncate over-long messages safely; always NUL-terminate
Default threshold after log_init is DEBUG (3)
Candidate designs all internal types — solution.c has plain functions only
